name: Bobbie Fish

goals.description: Build a good base in the brick factory.

memorableMoments: On the first day, I got a double laceration but managed to sleep on the floor of a brick factory. It was tense, but I survived. There is a surviver house nearby with loads of books and recipes. Will loot soon.

On the second day, a gimp I was standing on managed to bite my leg. I had to enter god mode for a moment to solve the issue. I had spent the entire day looking for a hammer, and managed to pick up a full bed in one go. Yay for good sleep with a pillow!
